title: Create src/lib/backends/index.ts — backend selector
description: Create a selector module that returns the appropriate AgentBackend based on CLI flags. Default is Copilot, with Claude and Docker as optional overrides. Throws if conflicting flags are passed.
acceptanceCriteria: getBackend({claude: true}) returns the claude backend
getBackend({docker: true}) returns the docker backend
getBackend({claude: true, docker: true}) throws with a descriptive error

steps.details: Create the file. Import copilotBackend, claudeBackend, dockerBackend from their respective modules. Import AgentBackend from types.ts.

Export: function getBackend(options: { claude?: boolean; docker?: boolean }): AgentBackend { if (options.claude && options.docker) { throw new Error('Cannot use --claude and --docker simultaneously. Choose one.') } if (options.docker) return dockerBackend; if (options.claude) return claudeBackend; return copilotBackend; }
Re-export the AgentBackend interface: export type { AgentBackend, BackendOptions, ParsedOutput } from './types.js'

technicalNotes: This is a simple factory pattern — the selector doesn't know anything about what the backends do
